title: Plugins
loadFailed: Could not load the plugin list
emptyInstalledText: Plugins add pages, widgets and tools. Browse the catalog to install your first one.
emptyUpdatesText: When a newer version of an installed plugin is available, it shows up here.
noMatchText: Try another word, or clear the search.
noSource: This catalog entry has no download address.
blockedText: This server only accepts signed plugins, so this one stays off. Turn on plugins.allow_unsigned in Settings to use it.
updateAsksMore: It asks for new permissions, you will see them before updating.
uninstallText: The plugin and its pages are removed from this machine. You can install it again from Browse.
systemPlugin: Installed by your package manager, so it is removed there. You can still turn it off.
settingsHint: Plugin options live on the plugin's own page. Permissions cannot be changed here: they are fixed by the plugin.

cap.rootText_one: Only the 1 fixed command it declares, through the Ervisio helper.
cap.rootText_other: Only the {count} fixed commands it declares, through the Ervisio helper.
cap.rootGroup: Without root if you are in the {groups} group.
cap.userText_one: Only the 1 fixed command it declares.
cap.userText_other: Only the {count} fixed commands it declares.
cap.ptyText_one: An interactive session of the 1 fixed command it declares.
cap.ptyText_other: Interactive sessions of the {count} fixed commands it declares.
cap.http: Use a service through its socket
cap.httpRoot: Use a service through its socket, as root
cap.httpText_one: Only the 1 kind of request it declares.
cap.httpText_other: Only the {count} kinds of request it declares.
cap.httpRootWarn: Control of this service can amount to full control of the machine.
cap.socketsText: Talk to these services on this machine.
cap.jobsText_one: It can set up 1 job that runs on a schedule or by webhook, as the user who sets it up, even when no page is open.
cap.jobsText_other: It can set up {count} jobs that run on a schedule or by webhook, as the user who sets them up, even when no page is open.
cap.jobsRoot: A job that needs administrator rights runs only after an administrator approves it.
cap.notifyText: To the email, Telegram or webhook channels set up in Settings.
cap.noneText: It cannot run commands or touch files.

consent.sandbox: Plugins run isolated from the console: they can only use the permissions listed here, with your rights, and ask before using administrator rights.

devUnsignedText: This plugin is not signed. It runs only because developer mode is on; with developer mode off it would be blocked.

frame.navigated: The plugin tried to leave its frame, so it was stopped.

moved.text: {name} no longer ships with Ervisio. Install it from the marketplace to keep using it here; it is signed by the Ervisio team.
